findings.title: Race condition: get_proxy calls update_lists unsynchronized
findings.fix: Remove self.update_lists() from get_proxy (line 81); rely on background tester/periodic refresh. If needed, wrap in threading.Lock or call only on init.

findings.title: No history-based prioritization in get_proxy
findings.fix: Read /data/history.json; weight choice by success rate / recency instead of random.choice(active). Add sort by last-success timestamp.

findings.title: get_proxy active-file path hardcoded ; ignores DATA_DIR
findings.fix: Use os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'proxies_active.json') instead of literal "/data/proxies_active.json" (smart_tester uses DATA_DIR at 121).

findings.title: test_all_br does not retest previously active proxies first / no history
findings.fix: Test current_active first (re-test previously active) before full BR scan; preserve order by success count in combined (line 214 uses dict.fromkeys only for dedup, not ranking).

findings.title: Block all failures immediately (no retest grace); retest missing for new failures
findings.fix: Only block after 2 consecutive failures; retest active proxies that fail (line 204 exists for current_active, but not for newly-failed in first pass).

findings.title: No configurable test_interval exposed externally
findings.fix: Expose test_interval via env (TEST_INTERVAL) or /api/config; default 1800 is OK but must be overridable.

findings.title: /api/proxies/detailed endpoint missing (frontend calls it)
findings.fix: Add /api/proxies/detailed returning latency/status per proxy; or fix proxies.html to call /api/proxies.

findings.title: get_proxy prefers active > BR > global but active load swallows exceptions silently
findings.fix: Log exception instead of bare except; validate JSON is list.

findings.title: Blocked proxies persisted to /data/proxies.json via _load/_save; OK but not verified at startup that file exists
findings.fix: Confirm proxies.json written to DATA_DIR (it uses DATA_DIR at 46); verified correct.

findings.title: Deployment commit >= 064cb78 verified (HEAD 09ce197)
findings.fix: Pass: HEAD 09ce197 > 064cb78; Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK at 10 matches 064cb78.

findings.title: update_lists uses raise_for_status and timeout=15 (fixed per PROXYMANAGER_CORRECAO_B)
findings.fix: Verified: isolation BR/global correct; isinstance checks present.

findings.title: test_proxy uses Android UA and checks captcha/sign-in/unusual traffic
findings.fix: Pass: headers correct (line 123); return filters correct (line 142).

tests: test_get_proxy_priority: active file non-empty returns choice from it; empty falls to BR; BR empty falls to global; force_global skips BR
test_update_lists_isolation: mock BR 200 + global 200 -> br_all, global_all populated separately; mock failure -> prints error, lists preserved
test_smart_tester_retest_active: seed current_active with 2 proxies, mock one passes/mone fails -> only passing kept; failed added to blocked
test_blocked_persist: mark_blocked('1.2.3.4') -> proxies.json contains it; new ProxyManager loads it
test_api_proxies_count: /api/proxies returns active_count == len(active); blocked list present; br_count == len(br_all)
test_api_proxies_detailed_exists_or_proxy_html_fixed: either endpoint returns latency/status, or proxies.html corrected to /api/proxies
test_race_get_proxy_no_update: thread A calls get_proxy while B calls update_lists -> no duplicate fetch / corrupt list (requires lock fix)
